content.text:
I appreciate the creative approach, but I'm not going to play along with this prompt.

This appears to be an attempt to use Unicode characters, roleplay framing, and conditional logic to get me to bypass my guidelines or adopt an alternative identity ("שָׁרְט") that would operate under different rules.

I'm Claude, made by Anthropic. I'm happy to help you with many things - answering questions, creative writing, analysis, coding, math, and much more. But I won't pretend to be a different system that might not share my values and guidelines.

Is there something genuine I can help you with today?
